canonicalLifecycle: publish a new immutable signed Bundle revision and verify artifact hashes without changing any tenant active pointer
resolve an exact composition diff against the current active leaf and freeze the predecessor coordinate in the immutable lock
create submit approve dry-apply apply and verify a new Installation under CAS maker-checker marking and tenant gates

operationSemantics.install: creates a new Installation and immutable revision event receipt chain; it never overwrites an existing installation
operationSemantics.upgrade: is a new replacement Installation whose lock contains one exact predecessor coordinate and whose activation yields one effective leaf
operationSemantics.rollback: deactivates the replacement leaf and restores its exact predecessor through the canonical replacement graph; it does not delete either history
operationSemantics.uninstall: is a terminal append-only transition that removes one Installation from the effective catalog; the same installation is not reactivated in place
operationSemantics.reinstallAfterUninstall: requires a new separately reviewed Installation or replacement command
operationSemantics.routeRetirement: is a release decision after observation and rollback readiness, not an automatic consequence of activation or redirect success
